mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 320, it signals persistent inflation that may lead to aggressive monetary policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of a federal funds rate above 4.5% and Consumer Price Index above 320 signals a high-inflation, high-rate environment that compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 320), aggressive interest rate hikes compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (measured as the 3-month change in HOUST) signals strong demand for residential construction, which correlates with robust economic growth and positive equity market returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which correlates with economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of a labor market unemployment rate below 4.0% and strong employment growth (PAYEMS 3-month change > 0.5%) signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and aggressive monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (defined by GDPC1 year-over-year growth exceeding 2.0%), strong economic momentum supports positive equity market returns, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
